Loss report: gitlab -> woodpecker
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/publish job.if (condition not expressible in Woodpecker CI; the workflow disabled)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/publish job.manual (a workflow that never runs has no manual start)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/publish/step/script step.shell (Woodpecker runs commands through /bin/sh -e of the image; a step with no shell from a GHA or GitLab source runs under bash there, so bash-only syntax fails when the image sh is dash)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/publish job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
